AntiPattern.Bad: Agent's exploration script launches the browser via `chromium.launch({ headless: false })` or invokes `npx playwright test --headed --ui`.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Visual UI modes targeted at a human operator (`AX_CLI_HEADLESS_FOR_AGENT`). Agent has no consumer for the rendered window; the run hangs waiting for human input or burns CPU drawing pixels nobody reads.
AntiPattern.Good: Default headless: `chromium.launch()` (no `headless: false`). Perception flows through `ariaSnapshot()`, screenshots written to disk for retrospective review, traces for failure diagnosis.
